*** Now with Moza Racing R3/R5 (Wheel and Pedals) Support ***

Premier VR training for safe and efficient belt loader use on the airport ramp!

Belt loaders are essential ground support equipment for loading and unloading baggage and cargo, but improper operation risks aircraft damage, injuries, and delays. This Meta Quest app delivers comprehensive, hands-on training in a virtual, zero-risk environment.

Familiarization Mode — Get acquainted with belt loader components, controls (steering, conveyor control, height adjustment, brakes, emergency stops), and basic functions through guided interactive tours and realistic simulations.

Inspection Training — Learn and practice thorough pre-operation and daily safety inspections: walkarounds for FOD, belt condition, tires, fluids, lights, horn, brakes, safety rails, and more. Learn based on industry standards to spot issues before they become hazards.

Operation Training — Focus on critical positioning skills: approach aircraft safely at controlled speeds, align precisely with cargo doors, adjust conveyor height, maintain safe gaps, use creep mode, and execute without collisions or damage. 

Perfect For — New ramp agents, recurrent training, ground handling companies, aviation schools, safety programs, and anyone seeking airside GSE certification or improved proficiency.

Safe. Cost-effective. Highly repeatable. Cut training risks, boost compliance, and enhance ramp efficiency with engaging VR practice.
